_about: Public-domain Thomas Hooker (1586-1647), preacher at Chelmsford, pastor at Newtown and founder of Hartford, Connecticut, for the Word Hoard: his treatises on the soul's preparation for and possession of Christ (1632-1640), the Survey of the Summe of Church-Discipline (1648), the Application of Redemption (1656-57) and his other sermons and tracts, from Internet Archive scans of the first printings (Early English Books and library copies), with the 1845 Poor Doubting Christian and two 1860 Hartford reprints. The early printings OCR roughly (long s, black letter). Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 39 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
